scenarios.evidence: Team-engine fixtures prove linear Git replay, directional cursor splits, lagging-P admission, failed nonempty SVN apply stop-and-retry, explicit no-target metadata revisions, and ignored-path noncollision. Intermediate tree and mapping assertions exist for those subcases. A second unchanged Git run is a no-op in R01_LINEAR. R01_SVNSERVE_MULTI_COMMIT_SVN_TO_GIT and R01_SVNSERVE_MULTI_COMMIT_GIT_TO_SVN drive disposable svnserve plus bare Git through production SyncEngine with ordered multi-commit tree/mapping checks and repeat no-op oracles. R01_SVNSERVE_BIDIRECTIONAL_ROUNDTRIP chains multi-commit SVN→Git and Git→SVN on one svnserve pair with remote tree/mapping checks and a second cycle no-op. Full product-level bidirectional acceptance and live upgrade remain open.

R02_R03_ROUTE and R02_LEGACY_DELETE keep legacy DELETE as disable-only: the registration, commit_map row, and per-repo secret remain, no managed-removal journal is written, and disposable SVN/Git remotes are byte-identical. R02_MANAGED_REMOVE and R02_REMOVE_RETRY add POST /api/repos/{id}/remove. It waits while a worker holds the repo, refuses symlink roots without following them, retries a visible failure, then removes only the owned local tree and exact per-repo secrets. Mappings, audit, sibling data, global secrets, and both remotes stay. R65 adds POST /disable, GET /removal/preview dependency metadata, parent-block HTTP 409 with preview, child removal that preserves parent/sibling credentials and paths, GET /removal recovery metadata, HTTP 409 reconciliation_required, explicit branch-pair remote opt-in with legacy destructive defaults preserved, and UI distinction between pause/disable and managed removal.

Merged #64-A/#74 give a durable v12 import operation ID and exact-ID cancel. R02_R03_ROUTE now asserts POST /import/cancel without an ID is HTTP 400, not 404, and does not flip synthetic in-memory progress. Real-engine cases cover connecting, mid-import, SVN child, git apply, LFS preflight, and uncertain cleanup holds. Cancellation is stop-safely, not undo.

A held partial import is skipped by the real scheduler tick. An existing Git target is refused before replay. reset=true is refused before enrollment. A stale operation ID cannot act on a newer active operation. Reconcile serializes against the per-repo busy slot. Two independent repos remain independent in 64A_CONNECTING. Cross-host writer fencing treats foreign holders as live until heartbeat exists, probes local PIDs only for stale takeover, refuses unenrolled writers when any lease row is present, enrolls begin/confirm/finalize paths, and blocks superseded epochs on import finalize and SVN-to-Git confirm without writing sync_records.

Full-import Git publication can persist intent, hold on a lost push reply or failed finalizer, and later verify the exact remote SHA with read-only ls-remote. One team-engine Git→SVN commit now persists intent, holds on a lost commit reply or failed checkpoint, and finalizes only a unique SVN UUID/path/ancestry/paths/tree plus durable identity match. Absent+unchanged authorizes resume of that one write. This is #64-B plus #64-C.

R06_CHECKPOINT remains the baseline_observation that skip-import checkpoints omit descendant Git work. Candidate admission/preview proves an SVN-derived tip is planned with pinned Git tip and baseline SVN revision, snapshot-bounded ancestry is enough, unsafe skip_import is refused without watermark writes, an existing SVN target is not treated as equivalent, and dry_run=false does not insert a scheduler-active child. Replay and publish stay later.

R06_EXISTING_TARGET_NOT_EQUIVALENT probes an already-copied SVN feature path read-only, reports equivalent=false, and does not svn copy or advance youngest. Full R07 dual-side reconcile remains #67 follow-up. The ignored team conflict control remains uncovered (#73).

RS-05 team fetch_svn_changes cases fail closed without scoped import proof despite stale global watermarks, advance from scoped checkpoints while ignoring global svn_rev, keep a pending pair isolated from a verified pair, and preserve single-repo global/git-log fallback when no repo id is set. RS-05 team fetch_git_changes / inspect_team_history cases fail closed without scoped Git cursor despite stale global last_git_hash, replay from scoped checkpoints while ignoring global git_sha, keep a missing-cursor pair isolated from a verified pair, preserve single-repo global fallback when no repo id is set, and advance scoped git cursors without clobbering global last_git_hash across two incremental cycles. RS-05 team sync_status cases keep import-baseline pending and terminal applying/idle transitions per-repo without clobbering sibling repos or global sync_state, map reconciliation_required honestly in get_status, scope svn-only advancement without global last_svn_rev adoption, and keep single-repo lifecycle on the legacy global sync_state key. Webhook forced is parsed as a hint and triggers the same polling inspection; it does not reset. Local dirty index, unpublished commits, and ignored-path collisions are retained.

L=R with lagging P replays. Missing/ambiguous cursors do not borrow another repo. Missing objects, shallow history, and ancestry-command errors are distinct from rewrite. Qualified merge DAGs replay in deterministic oldest-first topological order when the full frontier fits in one batch; merge-DAG backlogs beyond the cap continue in explicit oldest-first batches with durable git_replay_continuation state (handled commit set plus pinned admitted R) across restart. Legacy seeded unsupported_merge_dag durable blocks still refuse. Linear backlogs over 1000 continue in explicit oldest-first batches of at most 1000 commits per cycle; the handled Git checkpoint and durable continuation record are the restart cursor. While linear continuation is incomplete the bridge resets only through the current batch tip, conflict detection uses the full admitted P→R path and fails closed on partial coverage, and pending SVN file deltas defer the cycle with no bridge reset or writes while SVN-only metadata revisions drain without starving Git batches. Pending selection is hide/push P..R; the older-side engine replay proof is candidate_r10_merge_dag_older_side_replayed_with_delta; merge-DAG multi-batch continuation proof is candidate_r10_merge_dag_continuation_batched and cap=1/2 siblings plus candidate_r10_merge_dag_continuation_batched_distinct_trees_cap1/cap3, candidate_r66_merge_dag_continuation_survives_restart, and candidate_r66_merge_dag_continuation_missing_row_idempotent; conflict-coverage gate proof is candidate_r66_incomplete_conflict_coverage_fail_closed; SVN-only drain proof is candidate_r66_drain_git_batch_past_svn_only; visited-order skip proof is pending_frontier::visited_order_truncation_skips_older_pending_side. Durable UnsupportedHistory blocks (merge DAG and legacy backlog) survive restart; fetch_git_changes persists the same record on second-line UnsupportedHistory. Personal-mode merge-DAG containment is proven under R09/R66 personal cases. Policy/receipt supporting cases belong to the #63 compatibility reader.
